title: sentilab-open-check/1
description: The check response: geometry only, no thermal solve, not a score. geometry_sha256 is the server's recomputation and proposal_sha256 the canonical hash of the submitted proposal; both are null when the proposal did not get far enough to compute them. fits_tracks lists the manifest's tracks whose wire limit the routed wire meets (W <= factor x W_ref). no_participant_charge is true only while the check is sponsored and its MILP solve is capped; it is never assumed.

sealed.description: A sealed check: this response goes to its requester only and is never cached publicly.
